prior_work_distinction: Earlier bodies give propagation, deletion/feedback enumeration, cycle gadgets, pairwise LP gaps or a claimed unverified full theorem. This contribution provides a general binary-instance geometric SDP promise classifier with quantitative gap and bit-time accounting.
scope_assessment: For binary-alphabet permutation Unique Games, prove OPT≥1−√κ where κ is the minimum normalized signed-vector SDP violation. Consequently, for fixed rational ε,δ with ε<(1−δ)², the promised values OPT≥1−ε versus OPT≤δ are distinguishable deterministically in polynomial bit time using weak SDP optimization. This alphabet-two result does not refute or prove UGC with its tolerance-dependent larger alphabet.
